introHtml: Yellow drawstring backpacks offer high visibility and a cheerful pop of color, making them ideal for outdoor events, school spirit days, or safety-conscious giveaways. The bright hue ensures your logo stands out in a crowd, while the lightweight nylon or polyester construction keeps costs low for bulk orders. Add a one-color screen print or an embroidered patch for a clean, professional look that recipients will use again and again.
